question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**analysed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is discussing a study that compares the antioxidant power of various foods and drinks.
 
• The phrase "out of all the foods and drinks ______" implies that an analysis or comparison was made in the study.
 
• "Synthesised" means produced, which does not fit this context.
 
• "Consumed" means eaten or drunk, which would not fit the structure of the sentence here.
 
• "Assimilated" means absorbed, which is different from the action being described.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *(1) Numerous health benefits, including protection from cardiovascular disease and cancer, have been (2) attributed to antioxidants; however, according to dietitian Vinson, these benefits depend on how well antioxidants are absorbed and (3) utilised by the body. According to the study, coffee has more antioxidant power than other well-known foods and drinks, like tea, milk, chocolate, and cranberries. Dates had the highest antioxidants per serving out of all the foods and drinks (4) analysed__, but because dates are not consumed to the same extent as coffee, the latter comes out on (5) ______, according to Vinson.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Synthesised: Means to produce something by chemical or biological synthesis, not suitable here.
 
• Consumed: Means eaten or drunk, which does not fit the context.
 
• Assimilated: Means absorbed, but the context here is about analytical comparison.
